userDirective: 先看嘴唇主要问题，再调整；单调湿润没有明显提升。审核者须提出理由、反证、自审与实际前后比较。
targetObject: 同一原生人物的唇红组织与口周颜色过渡
targetDefectOrChange: R01 底色接近统一灰粉填充；新旧唇色重复合成，早期肤色快照覆盖后续皮肤层。
acceptedBaseline: R07 existing same-person host; R01 is an evidence-backed comparison, not user-accepted photorealism.
expectedArtifact: Isolated real 3D R02 workbench with same-view R01/R02/R07 comparison, fixed verified HTTPS and draft PR
protectedInvariants: R01/R02 canonical and display geometry, normals, native identity and rig identical
R01/R02 roughness, wetness, microfolds, lighting and camera identical
Original R07 host and R01 source files unchanged
No overwrite of PR303 archive-recovery work
No main mutation, merge, force push, external replacement mesh, image generation or baked shadow
boundedHypotheses: Stopping legacy tint before downstream skin layers and compositing native lip mask once removes residual outer pink without erasing perioral skin.
Only the outer lip-to-skin transition may need additional blending; preserve R01 tissue colour and independently compare full beauty with the transition disabled.
acceptanceGates: Actual beauty and albedo R01/R02 front/macro/oblique comparison reviewed independently
Old psLip no longer contaminates R02 lip-boundary albedo, positive R01/R07 control
Outer-transition ablation preserves source blocking and complete-skin composition; compare both full beauty and base colour.
Unchanged geometry/normals/roughness/camera/light; no changes outside conservative native lip ROI
Final HTTPS exact bytes and browser interactions verified; no screenshot substitute
deferredFindings: Inherited open-mouth inner-rim/corner continuity needs stage-by-stage vertex evidence; shallow-looking bright interior first needs semantic surface and material identification.
Existing R01 reduces long scratches and highlights; do not claim these as newly fixed
No calibrated subject-specific pigment map or measured optical coefficients

regressionCases.failure: Control reliability was mistaken for visual progress
regressionCases.gate: Require visible defect reduction in matched images and independent review; parameter response alone cannot pass.

regressionCases.failure: New broad/local pigment modulation made visible mottled patches; measurable change was not visual improvement.
regressionCases.gate: Remove rejected pigment modulation and added inner darkening; independently inspect the remaining outer transition against composition-only beauty.
